metadata.title: दहेज, दारू और डीजे पर रोक | Dahej, Daaru And DJ banned | Alirajpur
metadata.description:
In Madhya Pradesh’s Alirajpur district, tribal leaders have launched a campaign to eliminate dowry, alcohol, and DJs from tribal weddings, aiming to restore traditional values and curb social issues. Dowry has placed a severe financial burden on families, often leading to debt and disputes. Alcohol abuse during weddings has resulted in violence, accidents, and disruptions, affecting the sanctity of the ceremonies. The use of loud DJs, a modern addition, has overshadowed traditional tribal music and dance, eroding cultural identity.

Through community meetings and awareness drives, leaders are urging people to return to their roots, promoting simple and meaningful wedding ceremonies. The movement has gained support from elders and youth alike, recognizing that these practices have become obstacles to social harmony. By addressing these concerns, the tribal community in Alirajpur hopes to create a more inclusive and respectful society while preserving its rich traditions.
